topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the introductory framing, course overview, and expected learning outcomes for the cancer biology lecture series.

topics.label: Cancer as a failure of differentiation and tissue organization
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe cancer as a breakdown in normal cellular differentiation and tissue architecture driven by accumulated genetic alterations, along with the experimental approaches used to study tumor cells.

topics.label: Invasion and metastasis in benign versus malignant tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how tissue invasion and metastatic dissemination distinguish benign from malignant neoplasms both clinically and histologically.

topics.label: Stepwise tumor progression and the behavior of benign neoplasms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics illustrate the stepwise morphological progression from benign precursor lesions to invasive carcinomas using colorectal cancer and discuss the clinical risks posed by non-malignant tumors.

topics.label: Neoplasm classification and nomenclature
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the standard anatomical and histological naming conventions, as well as common exceptions, used to classify benign and malignant tumors.

topics.label: Mechanisms of cancer morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the physical, functional, and systemic pathways through which primary and metastatic tumors cause illness and patient death.

topics.label: Patterns of cancer incidence across tissues and species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the epidemiological frequency of different cancer types in human populations and across diverse animal taxa.

topics.label: Principles and applications of cancer screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the clinical rationale for early cancer detection and evaluate the screening methods, efficacy, and limitations across different organ sites.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and summary
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic closes the lecture by referencing the learning outcomes and providing housekeeping information for future practical sessions.
